confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Norway's high price level; no live listings or booking pages were consulted, and USD values are approximate conversions rather than live quotes. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately certain; July accommodation is least certain because peak and cruise-season rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against beer (cocktail about 1.6x beer, wine glass about 1.3x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation came from web search summaries citing the RBA exchange-rates page; the RBA table itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Norway's general price level, with Oslo and Stavanger as the closest Norwegian comparators; Bergen restaurant prices are set slightly below Oslo. July hotel and hostel rates are benchmarked to peak-summer rates in comparable Scandinavian and Western European heritage port cities.
